issue_context.title: Another axis may emit `changed` signal while `ScrollContainer` is scrolling
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v4.0.beta3.official [01ae26d31]

### System information

Linux Mint 21, Vulkan API 1.2.0, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti

### Issue description

`ScrollBar` of another axis may emit `changed` signal while `ScrollContainer` is scrolling.

This happens when the child controls are not as long as the `ScrollContainer`. 

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/a8c805be2947b211ee8b881d7a8bab7cdc86e170/scene/gui/scroll_container.cpp#L427-L431

![0](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/30386067/196849289-2a7ad09e-1bfb-403a-8751-7e15137c80ef.gif)


### Steps to reproduce

1. Download the MRP and run the control scene in it;
2. Scroll in `ScrollContainer` and watch.

### Minimal reproduction project

[Signal-issue-when-scrolling.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/9825959/Signal-issue-when-scrolling.zip)
